description: This is a YAML configuration/source file defining message classes and their fields for a software project related to network management or communication. The file specifies data structures used in CLI command and response messaging within the 'beerocks_message' namespace, including classes for enabling diagnostics, client management, hostap (access point) management, and specific network operations.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_ENABLE_DIAGNOSTICS_MEASUREMENTS
classes.description: Class representing a CLI action to enable diagnostics measurements with an integer flag.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_ENABLE_DEBUG
classes.description: Class representing a CLI action to enable debug mode, contains an integer flag for enabling.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_SET_SLAVES_STOP_ON_FAILURE_ATTEMPTS
classes.description: Class for setting the number of stop-on-failure attempts in slave devices.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_RESPONSE_INT
classes.description: Class for integer responses from CLI commands, contains status and current value.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_RESPONSE_STR
classes.description: Class for string responses from CLI commands, includes a buffer with size and content.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_CROSS_RX_RSSI_MEASUREMENT
classes.description: Class for cross-RSSI measurement data, includes client and hostap MAC addresses, frequency.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_OPTIMAL_PATH_TASK
classes.description: Class representing a task to determine optimal network path involving client MAC.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_LOAD_BALANCER_TASK
classes.description: Class representing a load balancer task with an access point MAC.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_IRE_NETWORK_OPTIMIZATION_TASK
classes.description: Class representing an IRE network optimization task.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_DUMP_NODE_INFO
classes.description: Class for dumping network node information identified by MAC.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_BACKHAUL_ROAM_REQUEST
classes.description: Class representing a backhaul roaming request with slave MAC and BSSID.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_CLIENT_ALLOW_REQUEST
classes.description: Class for allowing a client, including client and hostap MAC addresses.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_CLIENT_DISALLOW_REQUEST
classes.description: Class for disallowing a client with relevant MAC addresses.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_CLIENT_DISCONNECT_REQUEST
classes.description: Class for disconnecting a client, includes disconnect type and reason.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_CLIENT_BSS_STEER_REQUEST
classes.description: Class for steering a client BSS with parameters like disassoc timer.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_CLIENT_BEACON_11K_REQUEST
classes.description: Class for requesting an 11k measurement, includes SSID and operational parameters.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_HOSTAP_CHANNEL_SWITCH_REQUEST
classes.description: Class to request a channel switch on a hostap device.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_HOSTAP_SET_NEIGHBOR_11K_REQUEST
classes.description: Class to set a neighbor for 11k in an AP.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_HOSTAP_REMOVE_NEIGHBOR_11K_REQUEST
classes.description: Class to remove a neighbor for 11k in an AP.

classes.name: cACTION_CLI_HOSTAP_STATS_MEASUREMENT
classes.description: Class for measuring hostap statistics.
